patterns.note: A full-width, responsive image grid showcases project work, with each image having a subtle number and project title overlay.

The site uses an extremely oversized, bold, and wide sans-serif typeface for primary headings and brand elements, creating a strong, editorial statement, contrasted with a much smaller, legible sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A sophisticated, muted palette features a dominant off-white/cream background paired with a deep, rich reddish-brown for key text and branding, evoking a sense of warmth and luxury.
The initial large header 'JESSICA MILLE ARCHITECTE' and navigation links shrink and transform into a compact, sticky header upon scroll, with the brand name becoming a small 'JM' icon.
The footer prominently features the brand name in the same oversized, bold typeface as the hero, visually integrated with a subtle Golden Ratio spiral graphic.

technique_notes: To rebuild the transforming sticky header, implement a scroll-triggered state change that reduces the font size and element dimensions of the brand name and navigation, repositioning them to a fixed top position. The brand name also transitions from full text to a compact icon.

The display typography effect is achieved by using a single, very heavy weight of a wide sans-serif font at extremely large sizes for main titles and brand elements, often spanning a significant portion of the viewport width, with generous letter-spacing for impact.
The project grid is a standard responsive grid layout where each item is an image with a dark overlay on hover or focus, revealing a project title and a sequential number.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold display headings (~5-8x body text) create a dramatic visual hierarchy, while body and navigation text remain small and understated.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in hero and footer sections, creating a sense of grandeur, with balanced spacing within the project image grid.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its bold and dramatic use of typography, particularly the oversized, wide sans-serif for the brand name and main headings, which transforms from a massive hero element to a subtle sticky icon, and is artfully integrated into the footer with a Golden Ratio graphic.
